title: Deccan Sultanates: more rulers, offices, monuments

boxes.title: Qutb Shahis: added detail
items: **Shia**; ==**Qara Qoyunlu** (Black Sheep)== Turkmen from **Hamadan**; **7** rulers; Persian official
Sultan Quli: beaten by Krishnadevaraya at **Goni** (**1517**); fort renamed **Muhammadnagar**; killed by son
Jamsheed: patricide; won ==**Battle of Koulan**== over Bidar (**1544**); died of TB
Ibrahim: led **Talikota** alliance; ==first Qutb Shahi coins==; Golconda = "**Second Egypt**"
Muhammad Quli: **Dar-ul-Shifa** (**1595**), Jama Masjid (**1598**); **Kulliyat-e-Quli Qutb Shah**
Abdullah: with mother **Hayat Bakshi Begum**; Urdu peaked; Ibrahim called "**Chaucer of Urdu**" by some
